'''Kiizete''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Vortex Squadron]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She owned the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[V3-FX]] and operated out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kiizete was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
